text:
Anjali Patel: Heads up — BrightLine just swapped ownership on a dozen accounts in Salesforce during onboarding. We need an emergency reconciliation and a quick rules-of-engagement update so sales/solutions don't override each other.

Tom H.: Oof. which accounts? any active opportunities at risk? :eyes: 

Anjali Patel: A mix — two with live demos this week (ACME and Polestar), three POC stages, rest early-stage. I pasted the quick diff below.

Priya S.: can you drop the mapping CSV here? I'll patch the routing rules in the intake queue after we confirm owners.

Anjali Patel: CSV (columns: account_id, previous_owner, new_owner, notes):
```
acct_1001, marcos@example.com, devon@brightline.com, swapped by SI onboarding request
acct_1012, priya@example.com, devon@brightline.com, overlap with field motion
acct_1099, tom@example.com, devon@brightline.com, demo scheduled 4/18
acct_1100, anjali@example.com, devon@brightline.com, POC
```

Marco L.: Did they file paperwork? BrightLine said we agreed to co-sell for accounts in their named vertical (manufacturing). If so, fine — but we need documented ownership windows so we don't double-touch.

Devon (BrightLine SI): Sorry — we executed against the onboarding checklist and submitted the ownership bundle via the marketplace intake form. We flagged ACME and Polestar as joint-owned; the intention was to let BrightLine lead demo scheduling for the POC while Redwood supports pricing. Happy to revert if you want.

Tom H.: We need: 1) immediate rollback on ACME if Redwood should lead the demo; 2) formalized ROE (rules of engagement) doc for SI-initiated swaps; 3) queue automation so CRM-bot flags swapped accounts for 24h before final owner change.

Priya S.: I can do the CRM queue change. Proposed temporary rule: any SI-initiated owner change triggers a review tag and creates a private note for field owner and partnerships. Approver must click a link to confirm within 24h; otherwise ownership reverts. Thoughts?

Anjali Patel: Agree. Also add a field: "co-sell_role" with values {SI_lead, Redwood_lead, Joint}. That will help downstream routing and announcements.

Marco L.: +1. For the ACME/Polestar demos: Devon, can BrightLine confirm they will not send external invites to ACME contacts until we align on the demo script? We want one tight narrative.

Devon (BrightLine SI): Yes — we will wait. I'll add a comment on the two records and mark them Joint.

crm-bot: Automated note added to acct_1099 and acct_1001: "Ownership change by BrightLine pending review by partnerships and field. 24h hold placed." :white_check_mark:

Priya S.: Done — I updated the intake queue rule and created a quick patch:
```yaml
trigger: si_owner_change
actions:
  - add_tag: "pending-si-swap-review"
  - notify: ["partnerships", "owner"]
  - create_task: "confirm_si_swap"
  - schedule: revert_owner_if_unconfirmed: 24h
```

Anjali Patel: Perfect. Next steps:
- Devon confirm joint status in the marketplace intake form (owner: Devon) — due: today EOD
- Tom confirm whether Redwood should lead ACME demo or handoff to BrightLine — due: 10:30 PT tomorrow
- Priya to leave the 24h hold rule in place and prepare a short rollout note for Field Ops — due: today

Tom H.: I'll take ACME — sounds like it's strategic and we should lead. I'll coordinate with BrightLine on the demo script.

Devon (BrightLine SI): Noted. I'll update the marketplace form and add joint-play notes.

Marco L.: Can Partnerships create a one-pager for SI swap etiquette we can share with new SIs? Short bullets only.

Anjali Patel: I'll draft and share in #partnerships later today. Draft bullets will include: pre-approved account lists, intake form required, 24h review hold, co-sell_role field values, announcement cadence, escalation path.

Priya S.: FYI—I'll patch the automation in staging first then roll to prod after Anjali's doc goes live.

crm-bot: Task created: confirm_si_swap for acct_1001, acct_1099, acct_1012, acct_1100. Assignees: partnerships, field owners. Deadline: 24h.

Anjali Patel: Thanks everyone. Quick check — anything else blocking rapid rollout of the 24h hold?

Marco L.: No blockers from legal. Just make sure the one-pager includes the escalation contacts.

Tom H.: I'll follow up with BrightLine AM to make the rollout comfortable for them — we want them as partners here. :handshake:

Devon (BrightLine SI): Appreciated. We'll keep things coordinated.

Anjali Patel: Closing the thread once actions are done. Will post the one-pager link when ready. :rocket:
